mapper.insert: insert into ums_member_identity (member_id, real_name, id_card, id_card_hash, source, consent_time, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{realName,typeHandler=com.chengyinhub.business.security.PiiCryptoTypeHandler}, #{idCard,typeHandler=com.chengyinhub.business.security.PiiCryptoTypeHandler}, #{idCard,typeHandler=com.chengyinhub.business.security.PiiBlindIndexTypeHandler}, #{source}, #{consentTime}, #{consentTime})
mapper.select: select id, member_id, real_name, id_card, id_card_hash, source, consent_time, create_time, update_time from ums_member_identity where member_id = #{memberId} limit 1
select exists(select 1 from ums_member_identity where member_id = #{memberId})
mapper.update: update ums_member_identity set real_name = #{realName,typeHandler=com.chengyinhub.business.security.PiiCryptoTypeHandler}, id_card = #{idCard,typeHandler=com.chengyinhub.business.security.PiiCryptoTypeHandler}, id_card_hash = #{idCard,typeHandler=com.chengyinhub.business.security.PiiBlindIndexTypeHandler}, consent_time = #{consentTime}, update_time = #{updateTime} where member_id = #{memberId}
